posts.author: Kris Meerlo
posts.content_md:
I shot my first holo on Fuji holofilm.

The results are good the film is more then 1.5 years old and not refrigerate ( I bought it from Dave ).

- 4 sec exposure

- index matching 

- pyro developer + potasium bleach

- SP125 laser

- amber lumiled

![Image](http://www.myfilestash.com/userfiles/tirex/fujii1.JPG)

posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md: Looks good! I assume this is a single-beam reflection H1 (Denisyuk)? I found it hard to get good brightness on this type of holo with the Fuji film, but H2s where I could control the beam ratio were better. I assumed it was because the dyes seem to absorb a lot of red light, not leaving as much for the object as I would like for a Denisyuk. Maybe I should give it another try, varying exposure and chemistry more carefully this time...
